about: The Newman Firm works from Queens Boulevard in Rego Park and has twenty-one years by its domain registration, one of the longer histories here. It publishes no roster we could read, so nothing on the site names an attorney in the form G5 counts.
161 reviews at 4.8. Contingency fees, a free consultation and a 24 hour line, published. Its largest contentful paint on mobile is 19.6 seconds, and it publishes no case results we could read.
